Curriculum

01 / Communication Foundations

Understand your message, audience and purpose. Practise organising ideas before speaking.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

02 / Speaking & Listening

Practise clear expression, active listening, useful questions and appropriate responses.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

03 / Workplace Communication

Write professional emails, share updates and communicate clearly with colleagues and clients.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

04 / Presentations & Confidence

Structure a presentation, explain your ideas and respond to audience questions.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

05 / Interview Communication

Practise introductions, project explanations and answers to common professional questions.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

06 / Practical Communication Tasks

Apply learning through role-play, short presentations, writing exercises and feedback.

Practise the concepts with a focused task, review your work and document what you learned.

Projects & capstone

Complete guided practice and a final project or practical assignment relevant to Communication Skills. Define the goal, apply your skills and explain your process and results. Confirm the final project brief with the team.
